Conception-scoped keys only — the personal/per-machine half (agents, terminal, open_with, pdf_viewer) is seeded into the throwaway XDG settings.json by tests/screenshots.spec.ts, because a conception tree never owns those keys. workspace_path and worktrees_path below are readable defaults only: the spec rewrites both from its own <tmpdir>/condash-demo root at boot, so the seeded repos always sit inside the tree it wipes.
